definitions.gloss: to make someone do; to force someone to do
definitions.explanation: The causative auxiliary. It attaches to the nai-stem of ichidan verbs ({食|た}べさせる, {見|み}させる), and する becomes させる and {来|く}る becomes {来|こ}させる; godan verbs take せる instead ({書|か}かせる). The person made to act is marked with に or を, and the sense here is that they have no choice.

definitions.gloss: to let someone do; to allow
definitions.explanation: The same form when the person wants to act and is allowed or helped to: {子|こ}どもに{好|す}きなだけ{食|た}べさせる (let the children eat as much as they like). The て-form plus ください or もらう asks for permission: {考|かんが}えさせてください (let me think about it).

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧させる。
examples.english: I make the children eat vegetables.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧させた。
examples.english: The manager made his staff work overtime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{六時|ろくじ}→六時：10982_rokuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きさせて→起きる：00521_okiru⟧、⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}かせている→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Every morning my mother makes my little brother get up at six and walk the dog.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{考|かんが}えさせて→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please let me think about it a little.
I let my daughter wear the clothes she liked.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧わたし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{払|はら}わせて→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧ごちそうになっている⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で。
examples.english: Please let me pay today. You always treat me.

notes:
FORMS:
The causative verb conjugates as an ichidan verb: ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧させる, ⟦{食|た}べさせない→食べる：00396_taberu⟧, ⟦{食|た}べさせた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧, ⟦{食|た}べさせて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧. In speech the short form 〜さす ({食|た}べさす) is also heard.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧B⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧C⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧〜させる: A makes or lets B do C (the object C keeps ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧, so B takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧)
- A⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧B⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧〜させる: A makes B do something with no object ({子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{寝|ね}→寝る：00470_neru⟧させる, to put the child to bed); ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ suggests more force, ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ more consent
- 〜させて⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧: humble form, (let me) do — often stretched in business speech to ⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧させて⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧
- 〜させられる: causative passive, to be made to do (passive of させる)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- せる: the same auxiliary after godan verbs (⟦{書|か}かせる→書く：00477_kaku⟧, ⟦{行|い}かせる→行く：00119_iku⟧)
- 〜て⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to have someone do something for one — asks a favor rather than imposing
